children: is preparing for a product-heavy event on Sept. 9, with several new devices expected to broaden its lineup across phones, wearables, audio and home entertainment.

The main focus is expected to be the iPhone 18 Pro models, which could feature Apple's A20 Pro processor, improved battery capacity, satellite connectivity and a variable-aperture camera system. The company is also expected to unveil a foldable iPhone Ultra with displays measuring about 5.5 inches externally and up to 7.8 inches internally.
Wearables could receive upgrades as well. Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 are expected to gain updated processors and sensors, while the Ultra model could receive a thinner design.

Apple may also introduce AirPods 5 with longer battery life, along with an updated Apple TV using an A17 Pro chip and a refreshed Siri Remote. A redesigned HomePod Mini with upgraded Siri capabilities is also reportedly in the pipeline.
The breadth of the product cycle could shape investor expectations for Apple's hardware demand and growth.

title: Apple's Biggest Product Reveal of the Year Is Coming Sept. 9
